newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat called to open one to two cents higher.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat called to open one to two cents higher.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were called to open one to two cents higher on bullish input from the export sector, traders said.
USDA Thursday said U.S. net export sales of wheat for the week ended April 24 totaled 290,500 tonnes, above expectations for 100,000 to 200,000 tonnes.
Support also was expected to come from talk about cold weather forecast for this weekend in Ohio and Missouri which could harm some of the soft red winter wheat crop.
CBOT's Project A overnight trend for wheat was fractionally mixed.
